turns.instruction: Model the four-node, six-member tetrahedral truss in the attachment, with the exact coordinate expressions A=(0,0,0), B=(4,0,0), C=(2,2*sqrt(3),0), D=(2,2*sqrt(3)/3,3) m. A has X,Y,Z translations fixed; B has Z fixed but its Y restraint field is blank; C has Z fixed. Other unlisted translations are free. AD has 1.5 times the area of the other members. A 20 kN global downward force acts at D. Request D Ux/Uz/Uy, reactions Fx/Fy/Fz at A, and axial N in the first bottom-edge member AB. Clarify any essential missing restraint.

Confirm that B translation in global Y is fixed. Retain all other stated restraints and free translations. Analyze the current truss and report D Ux/Uz/Uy, A reactions Fx/Fy/Fz and AB axial N, with signed direction, locations, units, D load case and turn 2. Retain the reinforced AD area and the 20 kN downward apex force.
